components.name: Primary journal action
components.description: The main link on the cover or an article with a full-text PDF.
components.css: .submit { box-sizing: border-box; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 44px; padding: 12px 22px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--planb-color-accent-strong, #082952); color: var(--planb-color-canvas, #fffefa); font: 700 1.0625rem/1.6 Inter, 'Segoe UI', Arial, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .submit:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .submit:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid #7468ff; outline-offset: 3px; }
